summary: The evidence gate's decision line names a per-crate check's unlogged members: log_unlogged (how many), log_unlogged_crates (the first five as crate=record) and log_unlogged_observed_at (the oldest of their observed times); scripts/evidence-flip-ready explains such an unlogged_pass from that time, not from the aggregate's oldest member

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

schema.detail: Three more key=value fields on the shadow part of the decision line; readers parse fields by key.

rules.detail: evidence-flip-ready judges an aggregate's log=unlogged_pass by the oldest observed_at of the members the log does not list. Decisions are unchanged: the log view is shadow only.

compatibility.detail: A line from an older gate has no log_unlogged_observed_at; evidence-flip-ready then reads observed_at, as before.

recovery.detail: Revert the change; the added fields are shadow only.
